parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
Set the language type for request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas get-console-func-gray-status --condition vpcConsoleSwitch --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas GetConsoleFuncGrayStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Condition vpcConsoleSwitch --Lang zh
